summary: A committee member proposes applying the same loyalty test to both claimants for a state’s seats.
realLife: Oregon Representative Edith Green proposed that each Mississippi delegation face a party pledge in the minority report, and Rauh accepted the proposal in the delegates’ lounge.
gates: A proposed seating test currently applies unevenly to rival delegations.
inGame: needs: the proposed pledge text and each delegation’s signed response.

turns.what: Its delegates defer signing until they have read it.
turns.pulledBy: One slate asks for the text overnight.
turns.writesBack: The signature list marks their answers pending.

turns.what: The committee has to resolve their competing claims on other grounds.
turns.pulledBy: Both slates sign the same wording.
turns.writesBack: The evidence file retains both signed pledges.
